content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_8_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. We have the mapped_rxn and template_id 20810. Need to apply retrosynthetic template to target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule SMILES and template_id. Then output list of lists of precursor SMILES combos. Likely only one combination: amine and sulfonyl chloride? The reaction: aromatic amine attacks phenylsulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So precursors: aromatic amine (with NH2) and phenylsulfonyl chloride (ClS(=O)(=O)Ph-F?). In target molecule, the sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring with F substituent. So precursor amine is the aromatic amine part: the aryl amine with NH2 attached to ring (the part before sulfonyl). In target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

So sulfonyl chloride precursor: ClS(=O)(=O)C5=C(F)C=CC=C5 (para-fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride). The amine precursor: NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1 (the rest). So we need to apply template to get both. Use apply_template.

Let's call apply_template.
